items.name: concat
items.signature: fn concat<T, I>(elements: I) -> alloc::vec::Vec<u8> where T: AsRef<[u8]>, I: IntoIterator<Item = T>
items.summary: Concatenate the elements given by the iterator together into a single `Vec<u8>`.

items.name: join
items.signature: fn join<B, T, I>(separator: B, elements: I) -> alloc::vec::Vec<u8> where B: AsRef<[u8]>, T: AsRef<[u8]>, I: IntoIterator<Item = T>
items.summary: Join the elements given by the iterator with the given separator into a single `Vec<u8>`.

items.name: DrainBytes
items.summary: A draining byte oriented iterator for `Vec<u8>`.

items.name: FromUtf8Error
items.summary: An error that may occur when converting a `Vec<u8>` to a `String`.

methods.name: as_bytes
methods.summary: Return the original bytes as a slice that failed to convert to a `String`.

methods.name: into_vec
methods.summary: Consume this error and return the original byte string that failed to convert to a `String`.

methods.name: utf8_error
methods.summary: Return the underlying UTF-8 error that occurred. This error provides information on the nature and location of the invalid UTF-8 detected.

items.name: ByteVec
items.summary: A trait that extends `Vec<u8>` with string oriented methods.

methods.name: as_bstring
methods.summary: Convert a `&Vec<u8>` to a `&BString`, without copying.

methods.name: as_bstring_mut
methods.summary: Convert a `&mut Vec<u8>` to a `&mut BString`, without copying.

methods.name: drain_bytes
methods.signature: fn drain_bytes<R>(&mut self, range: R) -> DrainBytes<'_> where R: ops::RangeBounds<usize>
methods.summary: Creates a draining iterator that removes the specified range in this `Vec<u8>` and yields each of the removed bytes.

methods.name: from_os_str_lossy
methods.summary: Lossily create a new byte string from an OS string slice.

methods.name: from_os_string
methods.summary: Create a new byte string from an owned OS string.

methods.name: from_path_buf
methods.summary: Create a new byte string from an owned file path.

methods.name: from_path_lossy
methods.summary: Lossily create a new byte string from a file path.

methods.name: from_slice
methods.summary: Create a new owned byte string from the given byte slice.

methods.name: insert_char
methods.signature: fn insert_char(&mut self, at: usize, ch: char)
methods.summary: Inserts the given codepoint into this `Vec<u8>` at a particular byte position.

methods.name: insert_str
methods.signature: fn insert_str<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&mut self, at: usize, bytes: B)
methods.summary: Inserts the given byte string into this byte string at a particular byte position.

methods.name: into_os_string
methods.signature: fn into_os_string(self) -> Result<OsString, FromUtf8Error> where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Converts this byte string into an OS string, in place.

methods.name: into_os_string_lossy
methods.signature: fn into_os_string_lossy(self) -> OsString where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Lossily converts this byte string into an OS string, in place.

methods.name: into_path_buf
methods.signature: fn into_path_buf(self) -> Result<PathBuf, FromUtf8Error> where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Converts this byte string into an owned file path, in place.

methods.name: into_path_buf_lossy
methods.signature: fn into_path_buf_lossy(self) -> PathBuf where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Lossily converts this byte string into an owned file path, in place.

methods.name: into_string
methods.signature: fn into_string(self) -> Result<String, FromUtf8Error> where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Converts a `Vec<u8>` into a `String` if and only if this byte string is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: into_string_lossy
methods.signature: fn into_string_lossy(self) -> String where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Lossily converts a `Vec<u8>` into a `String`. If this byte string contains invalid UTF-8, then the invalid bytes are replaced with the Unicode replacement codepoint.

methods.name: into_string_unchecked
methods.signature: unsafe fn into_string_unchecked(self) -> String where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Unsafely convert this byte string into a `String`, without checking for valid UTF-8.

methods.name: pop_byte
methods.summary: Removes the last byte from this `Vec<u8>` and returns it.

methods.name: pop_char
methods.summary: Removes the last codepoint from this `Vec<u8>` and returns it.

methods.name: push_byte
methods.summary: Appends the given byte to the end of this byte string.

methods.name: push_char
methods.summary: Appends the given `char` to the end of this byte string.

methods.name: push_str
methods.signature: fn push_str<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&mut self, bytes: B)
methods.summary: Appends the given slice to the end of this byte string. This accepts any type that be converted to a `&[u8]`. This includes, but is not limited to, `&str`, `&BStr`, and of course, `&[u8]` itself.

methods.name: remove_char
methods.signature: fn remove_char(&mut self, at: usize) -> char
methods.summary: Removes a `char` from this `Vec<u8>` at the given byte position and returns it.

methods.name: replace_range
methods.signature: fn replace_range<R, B>(&mut self, range: R, replace_with: B) where R: ops::RangeBounds<usize>, B: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: Removes the specified range in this byte string and replaces it with the given bytes. The given bytes do not need to have the same length as the range provided.

methods.name: to_bstring
methods.signature: fn to_bstring(self) -> BString where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Convert this type to a `BString`.

methods.name: unescape_bytes
methods.summary: Unescapes the given string into its raw bytes.
